room_candles.prompt: Quiet room tone of a vast old library at night with soft crackling candle flames, gentle distant rain on tall windows, no music

page_turn.prompt: A single brittle old parchment page turning slowly, close up

hum_build.prompt: Low ominous sub-bass drone that slowly rises in intensity and pressure, cinematic tension, no melody

footstep_echo.prompt: One single heavy footstep on an old wooden floor echoing in a large dark hall

footsteps_approach.prompt: Slow deliberate men's footsteps on creaking old wooden floorboards, approaching from behind

flame_flicker.prompt: Candle flames fluttering in a sudden draft, soft airy whoosh

breath.prompt: A woman's soft nervous breath, close and intimate, a shaky inhale and slow exhale

leather_creak.prompt: An old leather book cover creaking under a tight nervous grip, close up

heartbeat.prompt: Slow, quiet, deep human heartbeat, steady, cinematic, no music

clock_tick.prompt: An old grandfather clock ticking slowly in a silent dark room, steady tick tock

candle_snuff.prompt: A single candle flame being snuffed out, short soft hiss and puff

pages_flip.prompt: Pages of a heavy old book flipping rapidly on their own in a gust, then stopping

ink_writing.prompt: A quill pen scratching slowly on old parchment, ink writing a line by itself, eerie and close
